engineering_BE.qualification: 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Mathematics as compulsory subjects
engineering_BE.minimum_marks: 50% aggregate in PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics); 45% for SC/ST
engineering_BE.age: Minimum 17 years as on December 31 of admission year

lateral_entry_BE.qualification: 3-year Diploma in Engineering (relevant branch) OR B.Sc. with Mathematics
lateral_entry_BE.entrance_exam: DCET (Diploma CET) or GITS Lateral Entry Test

admission_process: Step 3: Rank card / Merit verification by admissions office
Step 5: Payment of admission fee (within 3 days of allotment to confirm seat)
Step 6: Document verification (physical) and ID card issuance
documents_required_admission: Migration certificate (if from other state board)

ME_MSE_eligibility.qualification: B.E./B.Tech in relevant branch with minimum 50% marks
ME_MSE_eligibility.entrance: GATE score preferred; non-GATE students may be admitted based on merit and interview
ME_MSE_eligibility.note: GATE qualified students eligible for AICTE scholarship of INR 12,400/month

MBA_eligibility.qualification: Any bachelor's degree (minimum 3 years) with 50% marks
MBA_eligibility.entrance: CAT / MAT / XAT / CMAT / GITS MBA Entrance Test

phd_program.eligibility: Relevant master's degree with 55% marks; GATE / NET / SET preferred
phd_program.admission_schedule: Twice a year – June and December

documents_extra: Equivalent certificate from Association of Indian Universities (AIU)
